headline: Apartment construction in the first half of the year exceeded the 2022 maximum, according to experts | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Apartment construction in the Czech Republic in the first half of the year exceeded the 2022 maximum, according to experts. They said permitting has become somewhat easier but remains complicated, and do not expect housing to become cheaper.
why: Residential construction volumes indicate housing supply trends, which affect developers, building materials makers and house prices.
